T011 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (GPEucl n)),
  ((∀ (k : ℕ) (x : GPEucl k) (t : ℝ), GPhead (GPappend x t) = x ∧ (GPappend x t).ofLp (Fin.last k) = t) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : GPEucl (k + 1)), GPappend (GPhead z) (z.ofLp (Fin.last k)) = z) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (x y : GPEucl k) (t u : ℝ), dist (GPappend x t) (GPappend y u) = √(dist x y ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2)) ∧
          ∀ (k : ℕ) (z w : GPEucl (k + 1)),
            dist (GPhead z) (GPhead w) ≤ dist z w ∧ |z.ofLp (Fin.last k) - w.ofLp (Fin.last k)| ≤ dist z w) →
    (∀ (B : Set ℝ) (ρ η : ℝ),
        B.Nonempty →
          0 ≤ ρ →
            (∀ b ∈ B, ∀ b' ∈ B, |b - b'| ≤ ρ) →
              0 < η →
                BddAbove B ∧
                  BddBelow B ∧
                    IsLUB B (sSup B) ∧
                      IsGLB B (sInf B) ∧
                        sSup B - sInf B ≤ ρ ∧
                          B ⊆ Set.Ioo (sInf B - η / 2) (sSup B + η / 2) ∧
                            sInf B - η / 2 < sSup B + η / 2 ∧ sSup B + η / 2 - (sInf B - η / 2) ≤ ρ + η) →
      ∀ (s δ ε : ℝ) (V : ℕ → Set (GPEucl (n + 1))),
        0 < s →
          0 < δ →
            0 < ε →
              GPcover (GPproduct E) δ V →
                (∀ (i : ℕ), Metric.ediam (GPhead '' V i) ≤ Metric.ediam (V i)) ∧
                  ∃ a b,
                    ∀ (i : ℕ),
                      (V i).Nonempty →
                        a i < b i ∧
                          (∀ z ∈ V i, z.ofLp (Fin.last n) ∈ Set.Ioo (a i) (b i)) ∧
                            b i - a i ≤
                              (Metric.ediam (V i)).toReal + ε * 2 ^ (-↑i - 1) / (1 + (Metric.ediam (V i)).toReal ^ s)
'Translation.T011' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
